tuples.subject: penal_charge_form
tuples.quote: shall not be levied in the form of ‘penal interest’ that is added to the rate of interest charged on the advances.

tuples.subject: penal_capitalisation
tuples.quote: There shall be no capitalisation of penal charges i.e., no further interest computed on such charges.

tuples.subject: other
tuples.quote: The REs shall formulate a Board approved policy on penal charges or similar charges on loans, by whatever name called.

tuples.subject: other
tuples.quote: The quantum of penal charges shall be reasonable and commensurate with the non-compliance of material terms and conditions of loan contract without being discriminatory within a particular loan / product category.

tuples.subject: other
tuples.special_circumstance: loans sanctioned to ‘individual borrowers, for purposes other than business’ compared to penal charges for non-individual borrowers for similar non-compliance
tuples.quote: The penal charges in case of loans sanctioned to ‘individual borrowers, for purposes other than business’, shall not be higher than the penal charges applicable to non-individual borrowers for similar non-compliance of material terms and conditions.

tuples.subject: other
tuples.quote: The quantum and reason for penal charges shall be clearly disclosed by REs to the customers in the loan agreement and most important terms & conditions /
